diagram-cnc-work-zero.alt: Top and side views show the same work zero at the lower-left corner of the stock top.
diagram-cnc-work-zero.caption: G54 is the coordinate origin used by the posted program. Clearance is a travel height above the stock.

diagram-cnc-stock-review.alt: Three side views compare remaining material, a reached floor, and a possible gouge against the target depth.
diagram-cnc-stock-review.caption: Stock Review compares the simulated cut with the target. Orange marks remaining material, blue cut stock, and red a possible gouge.

diagram-cnc-pocket.alt: Top view of a circular pocket with nested cutter paths, and a side view of three cuts ending at Z minus 3.
diagram-cnc-pocket.caption: Pocket clears inside a boundary. Each ring shown is the route of the cutter center. A 3 mm pocket with 1 mm per pass reaches Z −1, −2 and −3 relative to stock zero.

diagram-cnc-profile.alt: Top view of a part outline with a toolpath offset outside it, and a side view with a holding tab.
diagram-cnc-profile.caption: Profile follows the boundary. An outside pass keeps the part on the inside of the cutter path. A tab leaves a small bridge to the surrounding stock.

diagram-cnc-drill.alt: Side view of a drill descending in three short pecks with small retracts.
diagram-cnc-drill.caption: Drill makes a hole at a selected position. Pecking breaks one deep plunge into smaller advances with retracts.

diagram-cnc-face.alt: A top-view stock rectangle crossed by zigzag cutter passes.
diagram-cnc-face.caption: Face mills the top flat. Adjacent passes overlap so the cutter reaches the stock between the lines.

diagram-cnc-adaptive.alt: An outline pocket with an island and a series of curved cutter movements around it.
diagram-cnc-adaptive.caption: Adaptive Clearing keeps the sideways cut small as it removes stock in an outline. The curved path is schematic; check the actual preview and where it plunges.

diagram-cnc-rough.alt: Cross-section of stock with stepped roughing passes above a curved target surface.
diagram-cnc-rough.caption: 3D Rough removes most of the material in layers. It leaves a small allowance for finishing.

diagram-cnc-finish.alt: A curved section with a cutter trace following the surface and a top view of evenly spaced parallel passes.
diagram-cnc-finish.caption: Parallel Finish runs neighboring passes and changes Z to follow the surface. It works well across shallow curves.

diagram-cnc-turn.alt: A rotating cylindrical blank with a stepped side profile and a cutter moving along its length.
diagram-cnc-turn.caption: Turning spins the stock and moves a cutter along the side to shape a round part. It uses a separate lathe program.

diagram-solid-extrude-extent.alt: Matched side views compare one-direction and symmetric extrusion about a dashed sketch plane.
diagram-solid-extrude-extent.caption: Extrude moves a profile in a straight direction. Symmetric splits the total extent equally on both sides of the sketch plane.

diagram-solid-revolve-extent.alt: Matched top-down arc diagrams compare a one-direction revolve and a symmetric revolve around an axis point.
diagram-solid-revolve-extent.caption: Revolve swings a profile about an axis. In Symmetric, the total angle is split equally on either side of the starting profile.

diagram-solid-loft.alt: Three differently sized section profiles connected by a smooth outer shape.
diagram-solid-loft.caption: Loft connects a series of profiles. The order of the sections determines how the result grows and changes shape.

diagram-solid-sweep.alt: A small profile and a tube following a bent centerline.
diagram-solid-sweep.caption: Sweep carries a profile along a path. The path controls where the result bends.

diagram-solid-fillet.alt: Side profiles show a square corner and the same corner rounded with a fillet.
diagram-solid-fillet.caption: Fillet replaces a sharp edge with a round transition.

diagram-solid-chamfer.alt: Side profiles show a square corner and the same corner cut into a flat bevel.
diagram-solid-chamfer.caption: Chamfer replaces a sharp edge with a flat bevel.

diagram-solid-shell.alt: Side section shows a solid block and an open thin-walled version after shelling.
diagram-solid-shell.caption: Shell hollows a body to a wall thickness. A selected face becomes an opening.

diagram-solid-split.alt: A block intersects a dashed plane, with two separate solids shown as the result.
diagram-solid-split.caption: Split Body separates a solid along a selected cutting tool such as a plane.

diagram-solid-pattern.alt: One blue feature followed by three equally spaced copies on a plate.
diagram-solid-pattern.caption: Linear Pattern repeats a feature or body in a straight direction at a specified spacing.

diagram-sheet-fold.alt: A flat blank marked with two bend lines and a U-shaped side profile after folding.
diagram-sheet-fold.caption: Fold uses construction lines as bend locations. The flat blank and folded result describe the same sheet.

diagram-mold-halves.alt: Two tooling halves separated to reveal opposing recessed cavities in cross-section.
diagram-mold-halves.caption: Create Mold cuts a cavity around the part and separates the tooling halves to expose it.
